source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 16 exercise solved (PDF 82-84): MCQ keys, model answers and step-by-step numericals; the printed numerical answers checked (16.1 and 16.7 corrected, MCQ 4 options misprinted).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Electrostatics / Static Electricity) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer: (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the work done on an electron by a potential difference of 100 volts?
(Electron ko 100 volt ke potential difference se guzarne par us par kitna work hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = qV = e × 100 V = 100 eV (yani 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁷ J). 1 eV woh energy hai jo electron 1 volt se guzar kar haasil karta hai, is liye 100 V = 100 eV. Option (b) mein number joule wala hai magar unit eV likhi hai, is liye woh ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. A parallel plate capacitor of capacitance 50μF is connected to a battery of 12 volts, the charge stored on each plate is:
(50 μF ka parallel plate capacitor 12 volt ki battery se jora gaya hai; har plate par kitna charge hoga?)

3. If a dielectric is inserted between the plates of a charged capacitor, the potential difference across the plates:
(Charged capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan dielectric rakhne se plates ke darmiyan potential difference:)
blocks.explanation: Dielectric polarize (qutbi) ho jata hai; us ki surfaces par ulte charges aa kar plates ke charge ka asar kam karte hain. Q wohi rehta hai magar E aur V kam ho jate hain (is liye C = Q/V barh jata hai), jaisa 16.5 ke voltmeter experiment mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. The potential energy of a system of two charges 8 μC and −8 μC separated by a distance 2 m is: ₒpe·´₆810J
(8 μC aur −8 μC ke do charges 2 m ke faasle par hain; system ki potential energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Eₚ = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r) = (8 × 10⁻⁶)(−8 × 10⁻⁶)/(4πε₀ × 2) = −64 × 10⁻¹²/(8πε₀) = −8 × 10⁻¹²/πε₀ J (taqreeban −0.288 J). Energy negative hai (ulte charges ek doosre ko kheenchte hain) aur −8/πε₀ wala option (c) hai; is ki power of ten ghalat chhapi hai (box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sahi jawab: Eₚ = −8 × 10⁻¹²/πε₀ J (taqreeban −0.288 J). Kitab ke options mein power of ten ghalat chhapi hai (exponents ke minus nishaan options ke bahar alag chhape hain). Option (c) (−8/πε₀) hi matloob jawab hai, magar is ki power 10⁻¹² honi chahiye, kyun ke μC × μC = 10⁻¹². Sawal ke baad chhape ajeeb huroof "ₒpe·´₆810J" toote hue formula ke nishaan hain, sawal ka hissa nahi; sawal sirf yeh hai: 8 μC aur −8 μC, 2 m faasla, potential energy kitni?

blocks.prompt:
5. The electric potential at a point A is 50 V and at B is 80 V. If the electric field between the charges is uniform, what can be said about the motion of positive charge from A to B?
(Point A par potential 50 V aur B par 80 V hai. Positive charge ko A se B le jane ke bare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai?)

options.text: Electric field ke khilaf work karna parta hai
Upar wala koi bayan sahi nahi

blocks.explanation: Positive charge khud ba khud zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf jata hai. A (50 V) se B (80 V) le jana yani kam se zyada potential ki taraf; is mein potential energy q × 30 V barhti hai, is liye field ke khilaf work karna parta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho ke potential "oonchai" jaisa hai: positive charge khud neeche (kam potential) ki taraf girta hai. Usay 50 V se 80 V (oopar) le jana aisa hai jaise patthar ko oopar uthana: hamein field ke khilaf zor lagana parta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. The rate of charging or discharging the capacitor depends upon the product of resistance and:
(Capacitor ke charge ya discharge hone ki raftaar resistance aur kis cheez ke product par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor kitni jaldi charge ya discharge hota hai yeh RC (resistance × capacitance) par munhasir hai; isi product ko time constant kehte hain (16.8).

blocks.prompt:
7. In a charged capacitor, the energy resides in:
(Charged capacitor mein energy kahan hoti hai?)

options.text: Plates ke darmiyan electric field mein

blocks.explanation: Energy plates ke darmiyan electric field mein store hoti hai; energy density = ½ε₀εᵣE² (16.7).

blocks.prompt:
8. A capacitor of capacitance 1 μF is subjected to 4000 volts potential difference, the energy stored in it is:
(1 μF ke capacitor par 4000 volt lagaye gaye; us mein kitni energy store hogi?)

9. The electric potential energy of a point charge q at some point in an electric field is equal to: ₒpe14qr
(Electric field ke kisi point par point charge q ki electric potential energy kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Potential V = energy fi unit charge, is liye V potential wale point par charge q ki potential energy U = qV hai (Eq. 16.21). (a) point charge ka potential aur (b) us ki electric intensity hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: "equal to:" ke baad chhape "ₒpe14qr" toote hue formula ke nishaan hain, sawal ka hissa nahi. Sahi sawal: electric field ke kisi point par point charge q ki electric potential energy kis ke barabar hai?

blocks.prompt:
10. The time constant of a capacitor discharging through a resistor is the time in seconds in which the initial charge Q₀ drops to:
(Resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ka time constant woh waqt hai jis mein initial charge Q₀ gir kar kitna reh jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q = Q₀e^(−t/RC) mein t = RC rakhne se Q = Q₀/e = 0.37 Q₀ aata hai (16.9). (0.50 Q₀ tak charge 0.69 RC mein girta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
16.1 If the absolute potential at a point is zero, what can you say about the electric intensity at that point?
Agar kisi point par absolute potential zero ho to us point par electric intensity ke bare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Wahan electric intensity zaroori nahi ke zero ho. E potential ki qeemat par nahi balke faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki raftaar (E = −ΔV/Δd) par munhasir hai. Misal: barabar aur ulte charges ke beech wale point par V = 0 hai magar E zero nahi (negative charge ki taraf hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Potential ko pahari ki oonchai samjhein aur E ko dhalaan (slope). Kisi jagah oonchai zero ho sakti hai magar wahan dhalaan phir bhi tez ho sakti hai. Isi tarah V = 0 hone se E = 0 nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
16.2 Is electron-volt a unit of potential difference or energy? Explain briefly.
Electron-volt potential difference ki unit hai ya energy ki? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Electron-volt energy ki unit hai. Yeh woh energy hai jo electron 1 volt ke potential difference se guzar kar haasil karta hai: 1 eV = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(1 V) = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J (charge × potential difference = energy).

blocks.prompt:
16.3 Define capacitance. Give its units.
Capacitance ki tareef karein aur is ki units likhein.
blocks.explanation: Capacitance (charge jama karne ki salahiyat): ek plate par itna charge jo us ka potential doosri plate ke muqable mein 1 volt barha de: C = Q/V. SI unit farad (F) = coulomb per volt (C V⁻¹); chhoti units μF (10⁻⁶ F), nF (10⁻⁹ F), pF (10⁻¹² F).

blocks.prompt:
16.4 Define dielectric constant. Give its mathematical form.
Dielectric constant ki tareef karein aur is ki mathematical shakal likhein.
blocks.explanation: Dielectric constant (relative permittivity): capacitor ki capacitance jab plates ke darmiyan insulator ho, aur jab vacuum (ya hawa) ho, un ka ratio: εᵣ = C_med/C_vac. Ratio hone ki wajah se is ki koi unit nahi.

blocks.prompt:
16.5 How does the capacitance of a capacitor change if the separation between its plates is increased?
Plates ka darmiyani faasla barhane se capacitor ki capacitance par kya asar hota hai?
blocks.explanation: C = Aε₀εᵣ/d, yani C ∝ 1/d. Faasla barhane se capacitance kam hoti hai; maslan d double karein to C aadhi ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.6 When will the energy stored in three capacitors be greater?
(i) They are connected in series.
(ii) They are connected in parallel.
Teen capacitors mein energy kab zyada store hogi: (i) series mein ya (ii) parallel mein?
blocks.explanation: Parallel mein (jab battery ka voltage V wohi ho). W = ½C_eV²; parallel mein C_e = C₁ + C₂ + C₃ (sab se bari), series mein C_e sab se chhote capacitor se bhi kam. Teen barabar capacitors C: parallel 3C → 3CV²/2, series C/3 → CV²/6, yani parallel mein 9 guna zyada.

blocks.prompt:
16.7 What is time constant? Give its definition.
Time constant kya hai? Is ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Time constant τ = RC, yani R-C circuit ki resistance aur capacitance ka product; unit second hai. Tareef: woh waqt jis mein discharge hote capacitor ka initial charge Q₀ gir kar taqreeban 0.37 Q₀ reh jaye (charge hote waqt isi waqt mein charge equilibrium charge q₀ ka 0.63 hissa ho jata hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.1 How is electric potential different from electric potential energy? Give an example to explain the difference.
Electric potential aur electric potential energy mein kya farq hai? Misal de kar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Electric potential kisi point par fi unit charge energy hai (field ki khasiyat); potential energy wahan rakhe gaye kisi khaas charge ki energy hai: U = qV.
Misal: jis point par V = 100 V hai, wahan 1 C charge ki potential energy 100 J aur 2 C ki 200 J hai, magar potential dono ke liye 100 V hi hai.

rows: Infinity se point tak unit positive charge laane ka work: V = W/q₀
Asal charge q ko point tak laane ka work, jo system mein store hota hai: U = qV
Point par field ki khasiyat; rakhe gaye charge par munhasir nahi
Rakhe gaye charge aur field dono par munhasir
Unit volt (J C⁻¹)
Unit joule (ya eV)
Point charge: V = (1/4πε₀)(q/r)
Do point charges: Eₚ = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r)
Misal: point par V = 100 V har charge ke liye
Misal: wahan 1 C ki 100 J, 2 C ki 200 J

blocks.prompt:
16.2 How does the concept of electric potential help us understand the motion of charges in an electric field?
Electric potential ka tasawwur electric field mein charges ki harkat samajhne mein kaise madad deta hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Simt (direction): azaad positive charge hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf tez hota hai; negative charge kam se zyada potential ki taraf jata hai.
2. Energy: jab charge q₀ potential difference ΔV se guzarta hai to us ki potential energy ΔU = q₀ΔV badalti hai aur jo kami hoti hai woh kinetic energy ban jati hai: ½mv² = q₀ΔV (Eq. 16.18). Is liye har point par force jaane baghair sirf ΔV se speed maloom ho jati hai.
3. Work: charge ko us ki qudrati simt ke ulat le jane (maslan positive charge ko kam se zyada potential) ke liye bahar se work W = q₀ΔV karna parta hai.
Misal: 100 V se guzarne wala electron 100 eV kinetic energy haasil karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.3 The electric field is negative gradient of electric potential. What does the negative sign indicate physically? Illustrate your answer with an example.
Electric field electric potential ka negative gradient hai. Negative sign ka physical matlab kya hai? Misal se wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
E = −ΔV/Δd. Negative sign batata hai ke electric field us simt mein hota hai jidhar potential kam hota hai, yani zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf. Field lines ke saath chalein to V ghatta hai; ulat chalein to V barhta hai.
Misal: do parallel plates 1 cm ke faasle par, positive plate 100 V aur negative plate 0 V. E = V/d = 100 V/0.01 m = 1 × 10⁴ V m⁻¹, jo positive plate (100 V) se negative plate (0 V) ki taraf hai, yani ghatte potential ki simt. Plates ke beech chhora gaya positive charge E ke saath 100 V se 0 V ki taraf jata hai; us ki potential energy kam aur kinetic energy zyada hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.4 When a capacitor is charging, no actual charge flows across the gap between the plates. But the current is still said to be flowing. Explain it.
Capacitor charge hote waqt plates ke darmiyan gap mein koi charge nahi guzarta, phir bhi kaha jata hai ke current beh raha hai. Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gap insulator hai, is liye us mein se charge nahi guzarta. Magar jorne wali wires mein charge behta hai: battery apne positive terminal se jurri plate se electrons kheench leti hai aur utne hi electrons doosri plate par dhakel deti hai. Is tarah ek plate par +Q aur doosri par −Q jama hota hai, aur circuit mein kahin bhi laga ammeter current dikhata hai.
Yeh current shuru mein sab se zyada hota hai aur capacitor ka voltage barhne ke saath kam hota jata hai; jab capacitor ka voltage battery ke barabar ho jaye (q = q₀ = CV₀) to current ruk jata hai.
Charge barhne se plates ke darmiyan electric field bhi barhta hai; wires ka current gap mein badalte electric field ki shakal mein jaari rehta hai (Maxwell ise displacement current kehta hai; yeh chapter se aage ki baat hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.5 Two capacitors can be connected in parallel or in series. Explain how does total energy stored differ in two configurations.
Do capacitors parallel ya series mein jore ja sakte hain. Dono tareeqon mein kul store hone wali energy mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Battery ka voltage V wohi ho to W = ½C_eV², is liye jis tareeqe mein equivalent capacitance zyada ho us mein energy zyada: parallel mein series se zyada energy store hoti hai.
Misal: do barabar capacitors C, voltage V: parallel W = ½(2C)V² = CV²; series W = ½(C/2)V² = ¼CV², yani parallel mein 4 guna.

rows: C_e = C₁ + C₂ (har ek se bari)
1/C_e = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ (har ek se chhoti)
Har capacitor par poora voltage V
V taqseem hota hai: V = V₁ + V₂
Charges alag: Q₁ = C₁V, Q₂ = C₂V
Har ek par ek jaisa charge Q
W = ½(C₁ + C₂)V² = ½C₁V² + ½C₂V²
W = ½C_eV² = ½QV₁ + ½QV₂
Zyada energy store
Kam energy store

blocks.prompt:
16.6 A capacitor stores energy. Is this energy stored on the plates, in the dielectric or in the electric field? Explain how does a capacitor store energy?
Capacitor energy store karta hai. Yeh energy plates par, dielectric mein ya electric field mein store hoti hai? Capacitor energy kaise store karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Energy plates ke darmiyan electric field mein store hoti hai (jahan dielectric ya vacuum hai), plates par nahi.
Kaise: charge karte waqt har chhote charge ΔQ ko pehle se maujood potential difference ke khilaf plates par pohanchana parta hai, is liye work hota hai. Yehi work electric potential energy ban kar store hota hai: W = ½QV = ½CV² (V–Q graph ke neeche ka area).
V = Ed aur C = Aε₀εᵣ/d rakhne se: W = ½ε₀εᵣE²(Ad), jahan Ad plates ke darmiyan volume hai. Is liye energy density = ½ε₀εᵣE², yani energy us poori jagah mein phaili hoti hai jahan field hai. Plates ko taar se jorein to yehi energy taar mein heat ban kar zahir hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.7 Why does the capacitance increase on inserting a dielectric between the plates of a capacitor?
Capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan dielectric rakhne se capacitance kyun barhti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Dielectric mein free electrons nahi hote. Plates ke field mein us ke atoms polarize ho jate hain: electrons field ke ulat thora sa khisak jate hain. Is se slab ki un surfaces par charges aate hain jo plates ke saath lagi hain, aur un ka nishaan saath wali plate ke charge ka ulat hota hai. Yeh induced charges plate ke charge ka kuch asar khatam kar dete hain, is liye plates ke darmiyan electric field aur potential difference kam ho jate hain jab ke Q wohi rehta hai.
C = Q/V aur V kam hua, is liye C barh gaya: C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d = εᵣC_vac (εᵣ > 1).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Polarize (qutbi hona) ka matlab: atom ka electron badal (cloud) field ki wajah se ek taraf aur nucleus doosri taraf thora khisak jata hai, atom toot-ta nahi. Is se dielectric ki surfaces par ulte charges nazar aate hain jo plates ke charge ko "kamzor" kar dete hain; isi liye utne hi charge par V kam aur C zyada.

blocks.prompt:
16.1 Derive an expression for the absolute electric potential at a point due to a point charge q.
Point charge q ki wajah se kisi point par absolute electric potential ka formula derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Absolute potential: unit positive charge ko infinity se us point tak (equilibrium mein rakhte hue) laane ka work. Point charge q ka field radial (shuaai) hai aur E ∝ 1/r², yani E badalta hai, is liye chhote qadam lete hain.
1. Radial line par do bohat qareeb points A aur B lein, q se faasle r_A aur r_B (r_B = r_A + Δr). Darmiyani point ka faasla r = (r_A + r_B)/2.
2. A aur B ke beech E taqreeban constant: E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²).
3. Points bohat qareeb hain, is liye arithmetic mean ≈ geometric mean: r² = r_A r_B, aur E = (1/4πε₀)(q/(r_A r_B)).
4. Unit positive charge ko B se A tak E ke khilaf laane ka work = potential difference:
V_A − V_B = −E(r_A − r_B) = E(r_B − r_A)
5. E ki qeemat rakhein:
V_A − V_B = (1/4πε₀)(q(r_B − r_A)/(r_A r_B)) = (q/4πε₀)(1/r_A − 1/r_B)
6. A par absolute potential ke liye B ko infinity par lein: V_B = 0 aur 1/r_B = 1/∞ = 0. Is liye
V_A = (1/4πε₀)(q/r_A)
7. Aam taur par q se r faasle par potential:
V_r = (1/4πε₀)(q/r)
V scalar hai; positive q ke liye positive, negative q ke liye negative; kai charges hon to kul potential sab ka algebraic majmooa hai. (Kitab steps 16.14 aur 16.15 mein q chhapna bhool gayi hai; upar q shamil hai.)

blocks.prompt:
16.2 What is a capacitor? Find the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor. What is the role of a dielectric in the capacitor?
Capacitor kya hai? Parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance maloom karein. Capacitor mein dielectric ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Capacitor: aisa aala jo electrical energy (aur charge) electric field ki shakal mein store karta hai. Parallel plate capacitor mein do parallel conducting plates hoti hain jin ke darmiyan vacuum, hawa ya insulator (dielectric) hota hai. Battery V se jorein to ek plate par +Q aur doosri par −Q aata hai, aur Q = CV.
Parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance:
1. Har plate ka area A, faasla d, darmiyan vacuum (ya hawa); d chhota hai, is liye plates ke beech E uniform (yaksaan) hai.
2. C_vac = Q/V ... (i)
3. Uniform field ke liye: E = V/d ... (ii)
4. Gauss's law se plates ke beech field: E = σ/ε₀, aur σ = Q/A, is liye E = Q/(Aε₀) ... (iii)
5. (ii) aur (iii) se: V/d = Q/(Aε₀), yani Q/V = Aε₀/d
6. C_vac = Aε₀/d
7. Darmiyan dielectric constant εᵣ wala dielectric ho to: C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d
Yani C plates ke area (C ∝ A), faasle (C ∝ 1/d) aur medium (εᵣ) par munhasir hai.
Dielectric ka kirdar:
1. Capacitance ko εᵣ guna barhata hai: εᵣ = C_med/C_vac. Us ke atoms polarize hote hain, surfaces par ulte charges plates ke charge ka asar kam karte hain, is liye utne hi Q par E aur V kam aur C = Q/V zyada. (Experiment: charged capacitor par laga voltmeter dielectric rakhne par kam reading deta hai.)
2. Insulator hone ki wajah se plates ko alag rakhta hai taake charge ek se doosri plate par na jaye; is se plates bohat qareeb rakhi ja sakti hain.

blocks.prompt:
16.3 Derive formulae for parallel and series combinations of capacitors.
Capacitors ke parallel aur series combinations ke formulae derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Parallel combination (C₁, C₂, C₃ battery V ke saath):
1. Har capacitor ki ek plate positive terminal se aur doosri negative terminal se jurri hai, is liye sab par potential difference V barabar hai.
2. Charges alag: Q₁ = C₁V, Q₂ = C₂V, Q₃ = C₃V.
3. Equivalent capacitor C_e usi V par kul charge rakhta hai: Q = Q₁ + Q₂ + Q₃ aur Q = C_eV.
4. C_eV = C₁V + C₂V + C₃V
5. C_e = C₁ + C₂ + C₃
Parallel mein kul capacitance alag alag capacitances ka majmooa hai.
Series combination (C₁, C₂, C₃ ek ke baad ek, V ke saath):
1. Battery C₁ ki pehli plate ko +Q deti hai; yeh us ki doosri plate par −Q induce karta hai, jis se C₂ ki pehli plate par +Q aata hai, waghaira. Is liye har capacitor par ek jaisa charge Q hai.
2. Battery ka voltage taqseem hota hai: V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃
3. V = Q/C se: V₁ = Q/C₁, V₂ = Q/C₂, V₃ = Q/C₃ aur V = Q/C_e
4. Q/C_e = Q/C₁ + Q/C₂ + Q/C₃
5. 1/C_e = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ + 1/C₃
Series mein equivalent capacitance ka ulat (reciprocal) alag alag capacitances ke ulat ka majmooa hai (C_e sab se chhoti capacitance se bhi kam hoti hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.4 Determine the electric potential energy stored in a capacitor from the area under the potential-charge graph.
Potential-charge graph ke neeche wale area se capacitor mein store electric potential energy maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Charge karte waqt plates par charge potential difference ke tanasub mein barhta hai (Q ∝ V, V = Q/C). Is liye V–Q graph (V khari axis par, Q leti axis par) origin O se guzarne wali seedhi line hai jo point B par khatam hoti hai jahan charge Q (OA) aur potential difference V (AB) hai.
2. Har naya chhota charge ΔQ pehle se maujood potential difference ke khilaf le jana parta hai; V, Q ke saath barhta hai, is liye har agle hisse par zyada work lagta hai.
3. Charging ko chhote hisson ΔQ mein baantein. Us waqt ke potential difference V₁ par ΔQ le jane ka work: ΔW = (ΔQ)(V₁). Yeh graph ke neeche ek patle rectangle ka area hai.
4. Kul work = aise sab rectangles ka majmooa = graph ke neeche poora area = right-angled triangle OAB ka area.
5. Triangle OAB ka area = ½(base)(height) = ½(OA)(AB) = ½QV
6. Yeh work electric potential energy ban kar store hota hai: W = ½QV
7. Q = CV rakhne se: W = ½CV² (aur W = Q²/2C bhi).
Field ki zabaan mein: V = Ed aur C = Aε₀εᵣ/d se W = ½ε₀εᵣE²(Ad), yani field mein energy density = ½ε₀εᵣE².

blocks.prompt:
16.5 Explain the charging and discharging of a capacitor by drawing circuit diagrams and graphs between charge versus time. What is a time constant for a capacitor discharging through a resistor?
Circuit diagrams aur charge-time graphs bana kar capacitor ki charging aur discharging samjhaein. Resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ka time constant kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Circuit (R-C circuit): voltage V₀ ki battery, do-taraf switch S (terminals A aur B), resistor R aur capacitor C. S ko A par rakhein to battery, R aur C series mein (charging). S ko B par rakhein to battery hat jati hai aur C sirf R ke saath jur jata hai (discharging).
Charging:
1. S A par: battery R ke zariye capacitor ko charge karti hai. Charge ek dam nahi aata, aahista aahista jama hota hai.
2. Graph (charge q khari axis par, time t leti axis par): t = 0 par q = 0, shuru mein tezi se phir aahista barhta hai aur equilibrium value q₀ = CV₀ par seedha (level) ho jata hai. Kisi bhi lamhe C par voltage V = q/C.
3. Ek time constant (t = RC) mein charge 0.63 q₀ ho jata hai. Chhota RC = curve jaldi oopar; bara RC = aahista.
Discharging:
1. S B par: ek plate ka +q, R se guzar kar doosri plate ke −q ko khatam kar deta hai.
2. Graph: t = 0 par q = q₀ = CV₀ aur charge exponentially (pehle tez phir aahista) ghat kar zero ki taraf jata hai: Q = Q₀e^(−t/RC). Voltage aur current bhi isi tarah girte hain: V = V₀e^(−t/RC), I = I₀e^(−t/RC).
3. Chhota RC = jaldi discharge.
Time constant:
τ = RC; unit second (ohm × farad = (V A⁻¹)(C V⁻¹) = C A⁻¹ = s).
Q = Q₀e^(−t/RC) mein t = RC rakhein: Q = Q₀/e = Q₀/2.718 = 0.37 Q₀.
Tareef: resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ka time constant woh waqt hai jis mein initial charge Q₀ gir kar taqreeban 0.37 Q₀ (37%) reh jaye. Charge aadha (½Q₀) t½ = 0.69 RC mein hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Discharging ko paani ki tanki jaisa samjhein jis se patle pipe se paani nikal raha ho: shuru mein tanki bhari hai, pressure zyada, paani tez nikalta hai; jaise jaise paani kam hota hai, raftaar kam hoti jati hai. Charge = paani, voltage = pressure, current = behne ki raftaar. Exam mein dono graphs (charging oopar jata curve, discharging neeche aata curve) aur dono circuits (S at A, S at B) zaroor banaein.

blocks.prompt:
16.6 Describe some uses of capacitors in various household appliances.
Ghar ke mukhtalif aalaat mein capacitors ke kuch istemaal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Electric fans aur motors: fan ki motor ke starting coil ke saath capacitor laga hota hai. Yeh motor ko start hone aur jaldi ghoomna shuru karne mein madad deta hai (starting coil ke current ka phase badal kar motor ko shuru ka torque deta hai). Washing machine, blender, chopper, grinder aur paani ki motor mein bhi yehi kaam hai.
2. Fridge aur AC: in ke compressor single phase motor se chalte hain jo khud aasani se start nahi hote. Bari capacitance wala "start capacitor" motor ko zor ("jump start") deta hai aur motor chal jaye to relay usay alag kar deta hai; "run capacitor" circuit mein reh kar efficiency barhata hai.
3. Time delay circuits: resistor ke saath capacitor (R-C circuit) fridge aur AC mein supply ko der se on karta hai taake bijli ke utaar charhao (fluctuation) se hifazat ho.
4. Camera ka flashgun: capacitor battery se charge hota hai aur shutter button dabane par xenon flash tube mein tezi se discharge hota hai; bara current gas ko ionize kar ke tez roshni deta hai.
5. Rectification: chargers aur adapters mein AC ko DC mein badalne ke liye capacitors istemaal hote hain.
6. Computer keyboard, touchscreen aur medical aalaat (defibrillator jo dil ki dharkan theek karne ke liye jhatka deta hai; CT, MRI, ECG, EEG mein noise saaf karna) mein bhi capacitors lagte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke fan ka capacitor motor ko "additional power" deta hai. Asal mein capacitor extra energy nahi deta; woh starting coil ke current ka phase badalta hai jis se ghoomta hua magnetic field banta hai aur motor ko shuru ka torque milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.1 A particle carrying a charge of 0.1 μC starts from rest in a uniform electric field of intensity 60 N C⁻¹. Find the kinetic energy acquired by the particle when it has moved 2 m. (Ans: 1.2 × 10⁻³ J)
0.1 μC charge wala zarra 60 N C⁻¹ ke uniform electric field mein aaram se chalna shuru karta hai. 2 m chalne par us ki kinetic energy kitni hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: q = 0.1 μC = 1 × 10⁻⁷ C, E = 60 N C⁻¹, d = 2 m, aaram (rest) se shuru
Maloom karna: K.E.
Field ka work (F = qE, faasla d) kinetic energy ban jata hai:
K.E. = W = Fd = qEd
K.E. = (1 × 10⁻⁷ C)(60 N C⁻¹)(2 m)
K.E. = 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ J
Jawab: K.E. = 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ J (kitab 1.2 × 10⁻³ J likhti hai; box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 1.2 × 10⁻³ J likhti hai. q = 0.1 μC = 1 × 10⁻⁷ C ke saath K.E. = qEd = 1 × 10⁻⁷ × 60 × 2 = 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ J banta hai. Kitab wala jawab tab aata jab charge 10 μC hota.

blocks.prompt:
16.2 What should be the potential difference through which an electron falls to acquire a speed of 2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹? (Ans: 11.4 V)
Electron ko 2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ speed haasil karne ke liye kitne potential difference se guzarna hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: v = 2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹, mₑ = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C (rest se shuru)
Maloom karna: ΔV
Potential energy ki kami = kinetic energy ka izafa:
eΔV = ½mv²
ΔV = mv²/2e
ΔV = (9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg)(2 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹)²/(2 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
ΔV = (9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 4 × 10¹²)/(3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹)
ΔV = 3.64 × 10⁻¹⁸ J/3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
ΔV = 11.4 V
Jawab: ΔV = 11.4 V (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.3 The potential difference between points A and B is V_A − V_B = 84 V, while the potential difference between points C and B is V_C − V_B = 24 V. What should be the work done on moving a 40 μC charge from C to A? (Ans: 2.4 × 10⁻³ J)
V_A − V_B = 84 V aur V_C − V_B = 24 V hai. 40 μC charge ko C se A tak le jane mein kitna work hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V_A − V_B = 84 V, V_C − V_B = 24 V, q = 40 μC = 40 × 10⁻⁶ C
Maloom karna: q ko C se A tak le jane ka work W
A aur C ke darmiyan potential difference:
V_A − V_C = (V_A − V_B) − (V_C − V_B)
V_A − V_C = 84 V − 24 V = 60 V
Work = charge × potential difference:
W = q(V_A − V_C)
W = (40 × 10⁻⁶ C)(60 V)
W = 2400 × 10⁻⁶ J = 2.4 × 10⁻³ J
Jawab: W = 2.4 × 10⁻³ J (kitab se milta hai). A zyada potential par hai, is liye yeh work field ke khilaf hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
16.4 A parallel plate capacitor has a capacitance of 6 μF when filled with a dielectric. The area of each plate is 1.2 m² and the separation between the plates is 9 × 10⁻⁶ m. What is the dielectric constant? (Ans: 5.1)
Dielectric bhare parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance 6 μF hai. Har plate ka area 1.2 m² aur plates ka faasla 9 × 10⁻⁶ m hai. Dielectric constant kitna hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: C_med = 6 μF = 6 × 10⁻⁶ F, A = 1.2 m², d = 9 × 10⁻⁶ m, ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²
Maloom karna: εᵣ
C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d
εᵣ = C_med d/(Aε₀)
εᵣ = (6 × 10⁻⁶ F)(9 × 10⁻⁶ m)/((1.2 m²)(8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²))
εᵣ = (5.4 × 10⁻¹¹)/(1.062 × 10⁻¹¹)
εᵣ = 5.08 ≈ 5.1
Jawab: εᵣ = 5.1 (koi unit nahi; kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.5 A 15 μF capacitor is charged till the potential difference across its plates becomes 300 V. Find the energy stored in it. (Ans: 0.675 J)
15 μF capacitor ko 300 V tak charge kiya gaya. Us mein store energy maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: C = 15 μF = 15 × 10⁻⁶ F, V = 300 V
Maloom karna: energy W
W = ½CV²
W = ½ × (15 × 10⁻⁶ F) × (300 V)²
W = ½ × 15 × 10⁻⁶ × 9 × 10⁴
W = 67.5 × 10⁻² J = 0.675 J
Jawab: W = 0.675 J (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.6 Two capacitors of 2.0 μF and 8.0 μF capacitances are connected in series and a potential difference of 300 volts is applied. Find the charge and potential difference for each capacitor. (Ans: Q₁ = Q₂ = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C, V₁ = 240 V, V₂ = 60 V)
2.0 μF aur 8.0 μF ke capacitors series mein jor kar 300 V lagaye gaye. Har capacitor ka charge aur potential difference maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: C₁ = 2.0 μF, C₂ = 8.0 μF (series), V = 300 V
Maloom karna: Q₁, Q₂, V₁, V₂
Equivalent capacitance (series):
1/C_e = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ = 1/2 + 1/8 = 5/8 μF⁻¹
C_e = 8/5 = 1.6 μF = 1.6 × 10⁻⁶ F
Charge (series mein har capacitor par ek jaisa):
Q = C_eV = (1.6 × 10⁻⁶ F)(300 V) = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C
Q₁ = Q₂ = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C
Potential differences:
V₁ = Q/C₁ = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C/2.0 × 10⁻⁶ F = 240 V
V₂ = Q/C₂ = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C/8.0 × 10⁻⁶ F = 60 V
Check: V₁ + V₂ = 240 V + 60 V = 300 V
Jawab: Q₁ = Q₂ = 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C, V₁ = 240 V, V₂ = 60 V (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.7 A capacitor has a capacitance of 3 μF. It is charged by a battery. When the potential difference between the plates is 240 volts, how many electrons have been removed from one plate and placed on the other plate? (Ans: 3.0 × 10¹⁵)
3 μF ka capacitor battery se charge kiya gaya. Jab plates ke darmiyan potential difference 240 V ho, to ek plate se kitne electrons nikal kar doosri plate par rakhe gaye?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: C = 3 μF = 3 × 10⁻⁶ F, V = 240 V, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
Maloom karna: electrons ki tadaad n
Plates par charge:
Q = CV = (3 × 10⁻⁶ F)(240 V) = 7.2 × 10⁻⁴ C
Electrons ki tadaad:
Q = ne, is liye n = Q/e
n = 7.2 × 10⁻⁴ C/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
n = 4.5 × 10¹⁵
Jawab: n = 4.5 × 10¹⁵ electrons (kitab 3.0 × 10¹⁵ likhti hai; box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 3.0 × 10¹⁵ likhti hai. C = 3 μF aur V = 240 V se Q = CV = 7.2 × 10⁻⁴ C aur n = Q/e = 7.2 × 10⁻⁴/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 4.5 × 10¹⁵ banta hai. 3.0 × 10¹⁵ electrons ka charge 4.8 × 10⁻⁴ C hota (maslan 3 μF par 160 V).

blocks.prompt:
16.8 Two positive point charges are held at two points 1.2 m apart. They are then moved towards each other so that their electric potential energy becomes double of its previous value. How much are they apart at their new positions? (Ans: 0.6 m)
Do positive point charges 1.2 m ke faasle par hain. Unhein qareeb laya gaya taake un ki electric potential energy pehle se double ho jaye. Ab un ka faasla kitna hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: r₁ = 1.2 m, U₂ = 2U₁ (charges Q aur q wohi)
Maloom karna: naya faasla r₂
Do point charges ki electric potential energy:
U = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r), yani U ∝ 1/r
U₂/U₁ = r₁/r₂
2 = 1.2 m/r₂
r₂ = 1.2 m/2 = 0.6 m
Jawab: r₂ = 0.6 m (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
16.9 A 100 μF capacitor is initially charged to 8 V. It is allowed to discharge through a 500 Ω resistor. Find the voltage across the capacitor after 0.5 s. (Ans: 3.6 × 10⁻⁴ V)
100 μF capacitor ko 8 V tak charge kar ke 500 Ω resistor ke zariye discharge hone diya gaya. 0.5 s baad capacitor par voltage kitna hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: C = 100 μF = 1 × 10⁻⁴ F, V₀ = 8 V, R = 500 Ω, t = 0.5 s
Maloom karna: 0.5 s baad V
Time constant:
RC = (500 Ω)(1 × 10⁻⁴ F) = 0.05 s
t/RC = 0.5 s/0.05 s = 10
Voltage ki exponential kami:
V = V₀e^(−t/RC)
V = 8 V × e⁻¹⁰
V = 8 V × 4.54 × 10⁻⁵
V = 3.63 × 10⁻⁴ V ≈ 3.6 × 10⁻⁴ V
Jawab: V = 3.6 × 10⁻⁴ V (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: e⁻¹⁰ calculator se nikalein (e^x button): e⁻¹⁰ = 0.0000454. 0.5 s mein 10 time constants guzar jate hain, is liye capacitor taqreeban poora khaali ho jata hai; har time constant mein voltage 0.37 guna reh jata hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab: 1 d, 2 c, 3 b, 4 c, 5 c, 6 d, 7 d, 8 a, 9 c, 10 b.
MCQ 4 ke options mein power of ten ghalat chhapi hai; sahi jawab −8 × 10⁻¹²/πε₀ J hai (option c) ("Kitab ki ghalti" box).
Numerical 16.1: sahi jawab 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ J hai (kitab 1.2 × 10⁻³ J). Numerical 16.7: sahi jawab 4.5 × 10¹⁵ electrons (kitab 3.0 × 10¹⁵).
Baqi sab numericals ke jawab kitab se milte hain; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
